panel.statusOrSayServerRestarting: status, or say Server restarting in 5
panel.usageIsMeasuredOnceThe: Usage is measured once the server has deployed.
panel.notPublishedYetTheAddress: Not published yet - the address appears once the server has deployed.
panel.inFivemPressF8And: In FiveM, press F8 and type this - or paste it into the direct connect box.
panel.aPlayerIsMatchedBy: A player is matched by the identifiers their game hands over, never by the name they chose - two people can pick the same name, and either can change it.
panel.addedHereTheServerIs: Added here; the server is told as soon as it answers.
panel.theyAreLetInThe: They are let in the next time they connect, whether or not they have ever been on this server.
panel.pasteItWholeAsThe: Paste it whole, as the game gives it: license:... or discord:...
panel.whateverTheGameHandsOver: Whatever the game hands over - a licence, a Discord id, a Steam id. It is shown beside anybody who has connected.
panel.itAppearsInTheGame: It appears in the game's chat.
panel.onlyPlayersYouAddCan: Only players you add can join
panel.everyoneElseIsTurnedAway: Everyone else is turned away as they connect, with a line telling them why. FiveM has no list of its own, so this is Polaris' and it is enforced inside the server.
panel.theServerIsNotRunning: The server is not running what turns people away, so anyone with the address can join right now. Polaris puts it back within a few seconds; if this stays, restart the server.
panel.whatOpensTheServerS: What opens the server's own console. Polaris uses it for everything on these screens; you only need it for a tool of your own.
panel.itTakesEffectAtOnce: It takes effect at once on a running server.
panel.theServerHasToBe: The server has to be running to be told a new one.
panel.aKeyIsTiedTo: . A key is tied to the address it was issued for, so a server that has moved needs a new one. It is never shown back.
panel.theServerPicksItUp: The server picks it up the next time it starts.
panel.keyHelp: The free key from <link>keymaster</link>. A key is tied to the address it was issued for, so a server that has moved needs a new one. It is never shown back.
panel.nobodyAtAll: Nobody is playing, and nobody has been added yet.
panel.savedRestart: Saved. Restart the server to run on it.

resources.whatThisServerRunsA: What this server runs. A resource that has just been added has to be started before it does anything.
resources.keepsPlayersOffTheServer: Keeps players off the server. Open it to everyone from the Security screen instead of stopping this.
resources.whatTheServerWillKnow: What the server will know it by. A folder of this name is replaced outright if there is one.
resources.notRunning: The server is not running, so there is nothing to list.
resources.none: No resources yet. Add one from a link, or drop a folder into the resources folder.
resources.ensureHelp: Starting a resource here lasts until the server restarts. To have one start every time, add an ensure line for it in the server config - Polaris does that for the resources it installs itself.
resources.badName: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores - it is a folder name.

rules.theseAreTheLinesIn: These are the lines in the server's own config. It reads them when it starts, so a change takes effect the next time it does.
rules.findASettingByWhat: Find a setting, by what it does or what FiveM calls it
rules.anythingAResourceAddsJobs: Anything a resource adds - jobs, economy, spawn points - is configured inside that resource, which you can reach from the Resources screen or in Drive.
rules.setTypeANewOne: Set - type a new one to replace it
rules.noMatch: Nothing here matches “{query}”. A resource can add settings of its own, and those live in its own config rather than here.
